definitions.free: Works on every plan, including free
definitions.unstated: Not stated anywhere in their own docs

rules: Only first-party servers documented on the vendor's own domain count.
Community servers, documentation-search servers and blog posts do not count.
plan_requirement is what the vendor's own pages say; 'unstated' means we found no sentence on plan, tier or price for the server.
Partial statements about one capability inside the server are coded as unstated.
negative_outcomes: Vendors where no first-party server was found were not recorded one by one in this edition; only the count is known (checked minus servers). The next full edition records every vendor's outcome.
